info.syllabusName: Tài liệu giảng dạy ngôn ngữ (Materials for Language Teaching)
info.description: The course provides learners with principles for selecting, analyzing, evaluating, and designing course materials as well as techniques of adapting and supplementing materials in English language teaching.
info.decisionNo: Ban hành theo QĐ CTĐT TDTU

clos.loDetails:
Specific knowledge: 
- understand the principles of selecting, analyzing, evaluating, adjusting as well as designing materials in foreign language teaching.

Professional skills: 
- evaluate, replace, adjust, supplement, and design teaching materials to suit learners’ learning objectives, needs and levels in foreign language teaching.

Generic skills: 
- enhance soft skills such as time management skills, critical thinking skills, problem-solving skills, and written communication skills
- develop abilities to make plans, search for, select and synthesize information

Attitudes and awareness: 
- raise awareness of the importance of relevance of materials to learners’ needs and levels.
- demonstrate independent as well as cooperative working attitudes
